input.evidence: Dusk infrared grayscale footage. The boxed cow is standing and facing right. Her head is down and turned behind another cow's flank or rear, so the face is hidden. I can see one pale ear tag, but its colour can't be read in grayscale, so it can't separate the candidates: Cow01 has a green button plus a numbered tag, Cow04 has a red/white tag, and Cow03 has a light tag. She has no visible white markings. Her body is medium-large and solid, which fits Cow03 or Cow01. Her position stayed the same at -20 s, 0 s and +20 s. She is not at the bunk or the waterer.
input.self_check: I checked her over time (-20, 0 and +20 s): she stayed stationary and standing. chew_check gave 3.14 Hz with peak_to_median 2.1, which is not rumination. My identity choice only follows the tracker's low-margin pick of Cow03. The grayscale frames don't show tag colour, so Cow01 or Cow04 are equally possible. A daylight frame or a readable tag would settle it. Her head being next to the other cow could mean social sniffing, but that wasn't clear, so I labelled her as standing.
